BOLLYWEEN DALLAS 🎃
DALLAS’ MOST EXCLUSIVE ROOFTOP BOLLYWOOD HALLOWEEN EXPERIENCEGet ready for an unforgettable Halloween night at rooftop of VICE PARK Dallas, one of Dallas’ premier nightlife destinations. Come dressed to impress!

EVENT DETAILSDATE: October 30, 2026
TIME: 10 PM – 2 AM
VENUE: VICE PARK Dallas
21+
DOORS CLOSE AT MIDNIGHT — ARRIVE EARLY.

COSTUME & DRESS CODENO COSTUME, NO ENTRY.

ID REQUIREMENTSA valid state-issued ID, driver’s license, or passport is required.
No other forms of identification will be accepted.
Photocopies or pictures of IDs on your phone will NOT be accepted.

BEHAVIOR POLICYManagement reserves the right to remove any guest from the venue at any time.
We operate a zero-tolerance policy for touching, harassment, inappropriate behavior, or conduct that disrupts the safety or enjoyment of other guests.
Guests are responsible for everyone in their party. No refunds will be provided for guests removed from the venue.

MEDIA & RECORDINGThis is a public event and photography/video recording will take place. By attending, you acknowledge that you may appear in event photos and videos and that the organizers may use this media for promotional purposes without additional notice or compensation.

PURCHASE POLICYALL SALES ARE FINAL.
There are NO REFUNDS, NO CANCELLATIONS, NO CREDITS, NO EXCHANGES, AND NO TRANSFERS after an order has been placed.
